reason: Build check A with the original 1e-5: the FIT mean changes by <= 3.7e-9 under a random order with other chunks (n60/f80in), the DEV scores by <= 1.2e-7 with 0 rank changes, but the raw caption encoder output itself (BiGRU over a padded chunk) changes by up to 8.3e-6 (centred vectors up to 1.38e-5) when only the chunking changes -> check A failed at 1e-5 (failure kept in NORMALIZATION_<base>.json). 1e-4 is the existing registered R39 step-0 student-vs-cache tolerance (joint_rule.equivalence_tol_max_abs; R47 observed up to 1.34e-5). A layout-dependent centre would move the vectors by the DEV-vs-FIT mean distance (l2 0.013-0.019 per peer / modality, NORMALIZATION files), far above 1e-4.
